name: What defines an accessible bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessible bathroom is designed to be safely and comfortably used by individuals with varying mobility needs. Key features often include wider doorways, grab bars for support, a curbless or roll-in shower, a comfort-height toilet, and a sink with clear space underneath for wheelchair access. The layout prioritizes clear maneuvering space and strategically placed fixtures to ensure ease of use for all occupants.
acceptedAnswer.description: An accessible bathroom features wider doorways, grab bars, roll-in showers, comfort-height toilets, and open sink areas for improved mobility.
